text: The **Payments API** takes card payments for Acme Journals. Team Hermes owns it.
norm: The Payments API takes card payments for Acme Journals. Team Hermes owns it.

text:
> **Info**
>
> The API is part of the Billing system.
norm: Info The API is part of the Billing system.

text:
| Endpoint | Method | Use |
|---|---|---|
| /payments | POST | Take a payment |
| /payments/{id}/refund | POST | Refund a _settled_ payment |
norm: Endpoint Method Use /payments POST Take a payment /payments/{id}/refund POST Refund a settled payment

text:
- The Payments API depends on the Ledger service.
- It calls the Fraud check API for each payment.
  - The call times out after 2 seconds.
norm: The Payments API depends on the Ledger service. It calls the Fraud check API for each payment. The call times out after 2 seconds.

text: See Payments API runbook for incidents.
norm: See Payments API runbook for incidents.
